summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, to submit a monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange detailing movements in authorized and issued share capital for August 2026. The report shows no changes in authorized share capital or issued shares for Class Y and Class Z WVR ordinary shares; balances remained static. The filing includes a public float sufficiency confirmation. This is a routine regulatory compliance submission with no special-situation event, such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or advisors involved. It is a periodic disclosure with no investor action or transaction to watch.
